name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted travel tracker and trip planner with an interactive world map, itineraries and a bundled PostGIS database.

alerts.message: Sign in with the username admin and the generated DJANGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. The account is created once if missing, so changing DJANGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD later does not change its password. Public registration stays open until you set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to True.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
